purpose: On train8m, does the fast windowed PBT match or beat a fixed-LR grid that covers the learning rates that worked on train800k? Validation-selected checkpoints of the train8m fast PBT and of the train8m fixed-LR grid (1.4e-5-2.4e-4) on the frozen Stage 2A holdout, paired with the Stage 3 fixed-LR and windowed-PBT checkpoints, which are re-evaluated as references. Primary comparison: fast PBT against the new fixed-LR grid. The Stage 3 sealed test is not used.
